result.title: Tandem: Serving Hybrid Linear-Attention GUI Agents on Mobile NPUs
result.summary: Smartphone GUI agents complete tasks in mobile apps by repeatedly reading the screen and asking a model for the next action. Mobile neural processing units (NPUs) enable local execution, keeping screen contents on the phone, but model latency accumulates with every action. Hybrid linear attention models reduce memory requirements, yet reusing their recurrent state requires checkpoints at the appropriate input positions. Agent requests retain instructions but rewrite recent history, so checkpoint policies designed for chat continuation can miss reusable prefixes. Retaining rollback states for speculative decoding can also move prompt processing off the NPU's matrix unit, adding overhead that outweighs decoding savings on short action outputs. A loaded model can further hold the NPU awake between tasks. We present Tandem, a runtime for hybrid GUI agents on mobile NPUs. Tandem saves recurrent state where consecutive prompts diverge, allowing later requests to reuse previously processed context. It keeps most prefill on the matrix unit and produces rollback states through a short per-token tail. Its verification kernel reads each weight block once for all proposed tokens. Between request bursts, Tandem releases NPU power votes without unloading the model. We implement Tandem in llama.cpp and evaluate it on recorded agent interactions across two Snapdragon generations. On a Snapdragon 8 Elite, Tandem reduces per-step latency by 30% for text-based screen descriptions and 16% for screenshots relative to llama.cpp's fastest NPU configuration, reduces energy per text step by 33%, and lowers standby power with the model loaded from 0.76 to 0.22 W.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Tandem，一个在手机 NPU 上服务混合线性注意力 GUI agent 的运行时：在相邻提示分歧处保存循环状态以复用已处理前缀，用短尾处理生成回滚状态，并以一次读入权重块的验证核完成任务间的 NPU 功耗释放，从而降低每步延迟与能耗。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作本身属移动端推理系统优化，未研究 latent 推理机制；但其循环状态检查点与回滚复用设计，可供核查 LVR 中状态缓存、注意力结构与前缀复用是否会丢弃任务必要信息。
